title: Design System: Luana Amaral — Biomédica Esteta

display.purpose: Hero h1 only; Spectral serif, two lines, balanced, max 22ch.

headline.purpose: Every section h2 (.section__title); Spectral serif, max 24ch.

title.purpose: Procedure names in the two-column list; the only body-scale Spectral.

body.purpose: Running copy in Hanken Grotesk; leads run 1.0625–1.125rem at 46–66ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked Hanken; logo role line and procedure group titles only. Never a kicker above a section heading.

emphasis.purpose: Spectral 500 italic in teal-700; exactly one inline word per headline.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Primary buttons at rest; the sticky header once scrolled.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Portrait media frame; contact form card; primary button hover.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: White CRBM credential badge over the portrait — the most-lifted element.

shadows.name: focus-ring-input
shadows.purpose: Input focus ring (teal-600 at 30%); replaces the outline.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The system's single easing curve for every transition and the signature.

motion.name: reveal-fade-up
motion.value: opacity 0.7s var(--ease-out), transform 0.7s var(--ease-out); from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(22px); }
motion.purpose: The one calm entrance for every [data-reveal] element below the fold.

motion.name: signature-portrait-wipe
motion.purpose: Authored hero moment: portrait wipes up, teal wash slides in from lower-left, badge settles at +0.5s. The only authored motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main call to action (agendar avaliação); solid teal on any ground.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Agendar minha avaliação<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3.5 8H12.5M12.5 8L8.5 4M12.5 8L8.5 12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--teal-600, #0F766E); color: #fff; font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", -apple-system, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; letter-spacing: 0.005em; white-space: nowrap; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(38,35,31,0.06), 0 3px 8px rgba(38,35,31,0.05); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--teal-700, #115E59); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(38,35,31,0.05), 0 18px 36px -14px rgba(38,35,31,0.16); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--teal-600, #0F766E); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 10px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action (ver procedimentos, falar no WhatsApp); outlined, fills teal on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-900, #26231F); font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", -apple-system, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #D8D0C2); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--teal-400, #38B2A3); background: var(--teal-50, #ECF8F6); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--teal-600, #0F766E); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Teal Icon Chip
components.description: Rounded-square holder for an inline SVG glyph; used across credential row, feature list, empty state.
components.css: .ds-icon-chip { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--teal-100, #D2F0EC); color: var(--teal-700, #115E59); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Contact form field; white on tint, hairline border, teal focus ring replaces the outline.
components.html: Informe seu nome completo.
components.css: .ds-form-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.45rem; font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-form-row label { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-900, #26231F); } .ds-form-row input { font: inherit; padding: 0.8rem 0.95rem; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #D8D0C2); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink-900, #26231F); caret-color: var(--teal-600, #0F766E); transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-form-row input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-500, #6B6259); } .ds-form-row input:focus { border-color: var(--teal-700, #115E59); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(15,118,110,0.30); outline: none; } .ds-form-error { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--err, #9C4221); min-height: 1.1em; }

components.name: Sticky Header Nav
components.description: Glass sticky header; hairline + shadow appear only once scrolled. Link hover wipes a teal underline in from the left.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; background: rgba(250,248,245,0.82); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #E6E0D6); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(38,35,31,0.06), 0 3px 8px rgba(38,35,31,0.05); } .ds-brand { display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-brand-name { font-family: "Spectral", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.3rem; color: var(--ink-900, #26231F); } .ds-brand-title { margin-top: 2px; font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teal-700, #115E59); } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.85rem; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding-block: 0.25rem; font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.925rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-700, #413B35); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav a::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -2px; height: 2px; background: var(--teal-600, #0F766E); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--ink-900, #26231F); } .ds-nav a:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; }

components.name: Portrait Credential Badge
components.description: White card overlapping the lower-left of the hero portrait; the system's most-lifted element.
components.html: Biomédica EstetaCRBM 10922-5 · Ativo
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; max-width: 240px; padding: 0.9rem 1.25rem; background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #E6E0D6); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(38,35,31,0.07), 0 34px 64px -26px rgba(38,35,31,0.20); font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 38px; height: 38px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--teal-100, #D2F0EC); color: var(--teal-700, #115E59); } .ds-badge strong { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink-900, #26231F); } .ds-badge small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--ink-500, #6B6259); }

components.name: FAQ Accordion Item
components.description: Hairline-divided disclosure; sans question, teal chevron rotates, answer opens via grid-template-rows.
components.html: O desconforto varia por técnica e sensibilidade individual.
components.css: .ds-faq { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #E6E0D6); font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-faq-q { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding-block: 1.4rem; text-align: left; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.05rem; color: var(--ink-900, #26231F); background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-faq-chevron { flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--teal-600, #0F766E); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-faq-q[aria-expanded="true"] .ds-faq-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-faq-a { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 0fr; transition: grid-template-rows 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-faq-a > p { overflow: hidden; min-height: 0; margin: 0; font-size: 0.975rem; color: var(--ink-700, #413B35); max-width: 62ch; } .ds-faq.is-open .ds-faq-a { grid-template-rows: 1fr; } .ds-faq.is-open .ds-faq-a > p { padding-bottom: 1.4rem; }

narrative.overview:
This is a single-accent, warm off-white world built to put professional trust signals — an active CRBM registration, a decade of practice, a natural-result claim — ahead of decorative aesthetic-clinic imagery. It plays the premium med-spa category standard (the Sculpt / Lasch finish class) straight, chosen deliberately by the client: firm grid, sane typography, one discreet accent, and a real portrait plus credentials carrying the confidence. The page ground is never pure white (#FAF8F5); cards and inputs are the only pure-white surfaces; every neutral is warm-tinted charcoal, never pure gray. A single teal/jade family carries buttons, links, icon chips, focus rings, and background washes — nothing else competes for chromatic attention.

Spectral (a calm serif) sets the hero headline, every section title, the procedure names, and exactly one inline emphasis word; Hanken Grotesk carries everything a visitor actually reads or acts on, including feature-card and FAQ headings, which are deliberately sans rather than serif. Corners are moderate (8–20px) and never a pill — a deliberate break from the superseded rose-boutique world. Depth is neutral warm shadows with real offset and blur on a small set of lifted elements; there are no colored halos and no hard offset shadows. Surfaces are flat by default and 1px hairline borders do most of the separating.

The system explicitly rejects: the previous rose/serif petal-frame world (soft-rose accent, Fraunces, pill buttons, authored SVG petal clip-path); the influencer-aesthetic hero built on glamour photography alone; and the three-giant-numbers stat template — replaced by a check-icon credential list. This world is not to be reintroduced toward the rose direction without a fresh client request.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white ground (#FAF8F5), pure white reserved for cards/inputs, ink always warm-tinted charcoal.
One accent: a teal/jade family on buttons, links, icons, washes, and focus.
Spectral serif for titles and one emphasis word; Hanken Grotesk for everything else.
Moderate radii (8–20px), never a pill; neutral warm shadows with real offset, never a halo.
At most one bordered/shadowed card inside a section; repeated items use hairline dividers.
One authored motion moment (the hero portrait wipe); everything else is one calm fade-up.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal/eucalyptus is the only chromatic family in the system. It never gains a second competing hue. --ok and --err are semantic status signals on the contact form only — never decoration, never applied outside form feedback.

rules.name: The Warm-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every ink and neutral is warm-tinted (toward brown/olive). A pure #000 / #666 / #ccc gray anywhere in this system is a bug, not a variant.

rules.name: The White-Is-A-Surface Rule
rules.body: Pure white (#FFFFFF) is only ever a raised element — a card, an input, the form, the badge. The page and its tinted sections are always warm off-white.

rules.name: The Single Emphasis Word Rule
rules.body: Spectral italic in teal-700 (em) marks exactly one word or short phrase inline within a heading — a punctuation device, not a second heading style. It never wraps a full sentence.

rules.name: The Sans-Heading Rule
rules.body: Repeating sub-heads (feature cards, FAQ questions) are Hanken 600, not Spectral. The serif is reserved for the page's structural titles, procedure names, and the brand wordmark. Do not upgrade a component heading to serif.

rules.name: The Standalone-Title Rule
rules.body: Every section h2 stands alone. No decorative kicker or eyebrow label sits above a section heading anywhere in this build. Uppercase labels exist only as the logo role line and as inline group titles within the procedures list.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears as elevation (portrait, form card, badge) or as a response to state (button hover, header scrolled) — never as ambient decoration on every card.

rules.name: The No Card-in-Card Rule
rules.body: A bordered or shadowed container never nests another. The feature list, procedure lists, and FAQ use flat hairline dividers instead of card chrome. At most one such card per section.

rules.name: The Warm-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is tinted rgba(38,35,31,...) (ink-900). No pure-black shadow, no teal-tinted glow, no hard/neobrutalist offset.

rules.name: The No-Pill Rule
rules.body: No border-radius at or near 999px anywhere. Buttons are 10px. This is a deliberate, permanent break from the superseded world.

dos: Do keep the page and tinted sections on warm off-white (--paper / --paper-deep) and reserve pure white for raised elements (cards, inputs, form, badge).
Do carry all accent work with the one teal/jade family — fill (teal-600), hover/label/icon (teal-700), washes (teal-100), hover fills (teal-50).
Do use 10px button radius and 8–20px elsewhere; scale the radius up with the surface.
Do separate repeating items (features, procedures, FAQ) with 1px hairline dividers, not card chrome — at most one bordered/shadowed card per section.
Do tint every shadow with rgba(38,35,31,...) and keep real offset + blur (--shadow-sm/md/lg).
Do treat CRBM registration, +10 anos, and the natural-result claim as first-viewport content in a check-icon list.

Do render unconfirmed content (procedures, testimonials, contact details) as clearly-signalled placeholders; let the testimonials section stand as an honest dashed-border empty state rather than fabricate quotes.
Do keep every [data-reveal] state visible-by-default in CSS; JS only arms the pending state via IntersectionObserver, with a 2500ms safety net and a try/catch force-reveal.

Do confine authored motion to the hero portrait wipe (clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0) -> inset(0 0 0 0), 0.9s --ease-out), with the teal wash sliding in from lower-left and the badge settling at +0.5s. Everything below the fold uses one calm fade-up (opacity + 22px translateY, 0.7s). prefers-reduced-motion neutralizes all of it.
donts: Don't use a pill or near-pill radius (≈999px) on anything. Buttons are 10px. This is a permanent break from the superseded rose-boutique world.
Don't reintroduce that world's language: soft-rose accent, Fraunces, or an authored organic petal / clip-path silhouette. No client request, no reintroduction.
Don't introduce a second accent hue, a pure-gray neutral, or a colored/halo/hard-offset shadow.
Don't stack a bordered or shadowed container inside another (the No Card-in-Card rule).
Don't set a feature-card or FAQ heading in Spectral — repeating sub-heads are Hanken 600. Reserve the serif for section titles, procedure names, and the wordmark.
Don't add a kicker or eyebrow label above a section heading; every h2 stands alone.
Don't rebuild the hero credential row as a three-giant-numbers stat bar — it is a check-icon proof list.
Don't spend a second authored motion moment anywhere else; below-the-fold content gets the one shared fade-up only.
